FN-TBRHM19-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 174
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 174 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Attorney
General for the enforcement of this bill; however, these obligations may be offset by any
damages or attorney's fees that are recovered from violators of the provisions of this bill and
retained by the Attorney General.
